neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Combines persistence of real zeros under increasing deformation time with a sharp threshold Λ, identifies RH with Λ at most zero, and explains Newman's opposite inequality as the claim that RH is at the boundary of instability under perturbation.

section_entries.label: 3. Appendix and acknowledgement
section_entries.mathematical_role: Supplies the quantitative proof of the unit-interval zero-count bound used in the tail estimate; the final acknowledgement is nonmathematical.

unit_result_entry.title: Explicit error absorption proves the unit-interval zero-count certificate
unit_result_entry.why_material: Separates the smooth main term from the zero-counting error, bounds the main-term increment using a logarithmic expansion, and absorbs logarithmic-error and constant terms into fractions of log T above the stated threshold, establishing the local density estimate used in u007.

unit_dependency_entry.context_note: This is the source's internal certificate for u006 and therefore closes the analytic dependency behind the remote-tail calculation.
unit_dependency_entry.representation_dependency: Lines 493-523 contain severe formula-layout damage and are quarantined rather than reconstructed. Prose at lines 524-525 identifies the alternating-series bound, and lines 525-566 preserve the subsequent explicit inequalities, but the entire derivation requires original-scan verification before formula-level use.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: The close-pair gap dominates sensitivity to the interaction estimate
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Explains through a small-parameter expansion that the leading gap-squared term already nearly equals the reported Λ bound, so substantial conservatism in the global interaction estimate has little effect. This clarifies why the certification can succeed without highly accurate knowledge of every zero.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: An explicit global counting formula can be converted into unit-interval density control and then into a convergent inverse-square tail estimate, providing analytic coverage beyond the computed zero window.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The constants and threshold are those stated in this source, and the appendix's formula-damaged main-term algebra needs scan verification.
